about.heroSubtitle: Connecting professionals. Sharing knowledge. Building the future.
about.whoTitle: A home for Bangladesh's knitting programmers
about.whoText: JPPHAF — Jacquard Programmer Panel Humanitarian Assistance Fund — is a professional community and assistance fund for people working in computerized flat knitting and sweater machine programming. Our members work across Dhaka, Gazipur, Narayanganj, Chattogram and beyond — turning designs into the knitwear Bangladesh exports to the world.
mission: Standing by members in hard times
about.visionText: To build a strong, connected and respected community of computerized flat knitting programmers across Bangladesh — where no programmer faces hard times alone.

support.title: Professional Networking
support.text: Meet programmers, team leads and factories across the industry.

support.title: Knowledge Sharing
support.text: Share techniques for STOLL, Shima Seiki and pattern problem-solving.

support.title: Community Programs
support.text: Meetups, reunions and chapter meetings throughout the year.

support.title: Career Development
support.text: Training, mentoring and support to grow your programming career.

about.fundText: Four simple steps — everyone stands by everyone.

steps.title: Join
steps.text: Register on the site. An admin checks and approves your membership.

steps.title: Pay 200 Tk monthly
steps.text: Contribute 200 Tk every month — by bKash, Nagad, Rocket, bank or cash.

steps.title: Apply when in need
steps.text: Apply for help in case of illness, accident, death, job loss or another hardship.

steps.title: Committee decides
steps.text: Committee members vote on each request, approve it and deliver the assistance.

about.transparencyText: How much was collected, who received how much, and what is left in the fund — all figures are in the Fund Report, which members can see after logging in.

chatBlocked.unblocked: Member unblocked. You can both send messages again.

chatReports.privacy: Admins cannot read members' chats. This copy of one message was sent by the member who reported it.

push.title: Phone notifications
push.hint: Get a notification on this phone or computer even when the website is closed.

push.notAllowed: You did not allow notifications. Press On again and choose “Allow”.
